name: lifestyle-v1
description: Video-first lifestyle reel matched to the operator's reference Reel (seoul_jip_deco × yesimdiane): real footage, fast hard cuts (~1.8 s), one short single-line Korean caption per phrase, centred slightly below the middle, regular-weight white text with a thin dark edge.

reference.source: Operator reference Reel (Google Drive screen recording, 2026-10-09), measured with FFmpeg + pixel analysis; video area 1206x2028 visible of a 9:16 frame
reference.shots: ~16 shots in ~27 s; mean ~1.7 s, range 0.9-3.5 s; hard cuts only, motion comes from handheld camera / in-camera whip pans
reference.subtitle: Korean caption centre ~56% of height, glyph ~47 px at 1080 wide, regular weight, white with thin dark edge, single line, centred; small English translation below at ~61% (~25 px)
reference.persistentCta: '댓글에 '타일' 남겨주세요' centre ~74.5%, ~41 px, visible for the whole video
reference.footage: creator on camera, hands handling the product, POV feet on the product, texture close-ups, wide shot of the space; natural daylight; no graphics or slides

translation.comment: Operator decision: Korean subtitles only (the reference also shows a small English line).

persistentCta.comment: Operator decision (matches the reference): small comment-keyword line for the whole video, lower safe area. {키워드} = the reel's ManyChat keyword (PRODUCTS.'ManyChat 키워드' if set).

narration.comment: minCharsPerSec: conservative (slow) Korean speaking rate used to predict scene length before any TTS call; cached lines use their real duration.

disclosure.comment: Operator decision: the Coupang Partners disclosure goes in the Instagram caption (first line [광고] + full sentence), not in the video. Set inVideo to true to show it at the start and end of the video.

assets.comment: One clip per scene (Google Flow: 8 s); the renderer takes several cuts from it. DEMO/BENEFIT/CTA must show the product (operator checks it matches the real product at video review ③).

flowClip.comment: Google Flow clip length. Each clip must cover its part of a scene (≤ clipSec − marginSec); longer scenes need extra clips (S3b.mp4 …). The signed job's clipSec wins if present.
